title: Yet another bingo map compat
description: This mod adds compatibility between yet another bingo and Xaero's worldmap as well as Journeymap, by resetting your map when a new bingo round starts.
body:
This is a very simple mixin mod that deletes all map data from Xaero's worldmap or Journeymap when a round of Bingo starts.

That's all it does! For now. 

I might still implement some configuration in the future.

If you've got feedback, feel free to open up an issue on github or join the discord server!
